## Prepared release notes for 0.10.0 (draft for the release step)

### Features
- #82 Add optional user-presence access control to `SymairaKeychain` — new opt-in `save(_:key:requireUserPresence:)` backed by `SecAccessControl` (device passcode); existing behavior unchanged.

### Changed
- #83 Stream asset downloads and split `UpdateApplier` into focused helpers — downloads stream to disk in 64 KiB chunks instead of buffering up to 1 GiB in memory; incremental SHA256; per-chunk progress callback; internal refactor with no public API change.

### Security
- #69 Harden error redaction against provider-prefixed token shapes (GitHub `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`/`ghs_`/`ghr_`/`github_pat_`, Slack `xox*`, Stripe `sk_live_`, AWS `AKIA`/`ASIA`, dotted JWTs).

### Fixed
- README Modules table now lists `SymairaMCP`; removed dead Discussions contact link from issue templates (#69).

### Tests
- #79, #80, #81 — coverage additions (ingest-contract error surface, MCPTypes Codable/accessors, auto-update preference store and launch hook).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-appkit/compare/0.9.2...0.10.0
